verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI capability in the evidence is 'AI-powered creation of meeting minutes' in the annual report/compliance offering. This is a single, narrow AI-generated task, not a general built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Other help channels cited are human specialists and attorneys, not AI. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent, the ability to delegate multiple or arbitrary tasks to it, documentation of how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
